correctness.rationale: C=PASS. Use published Johnson strong-two-monophonicity to identify monophonic complex as clique complex plus precisely 3*C(n,4) free 1-faces on disjoint root-edge pairs. Published Goyal lemma gives H_1 of clique subcomplex zero and connectedness. The relative chain complex is zero outside degree 1 and free on oriented extra one-cells; the equivariant long exact sequence induces a canonical integral Z[S_n]-module isomorphism to those cells. Stabilizer H=(S2 wr S2)xS_{n-4} acts by -1 precisely on block exchanges; induction recovers all n basis elements. For S4 the three-dimensional signed matching module has standard character #fixed ground labels-1 and is Specht (3,1); transitivity and Pieri yield multiplicity-free rational Specht decomposition, valid at n=4,5,6 and stable n>=7. Exact finite code checks all 24 S4 actions, signed traces and dimensions n=4..9, direct induced-path counts n=3..6 and mod2 homology n=4..7. Infinite proof is algebraic-topological, not extrapolated.

originality.rationale: The new claim is solely the integral S_n-first-homology module and full signed character/multiplicity-free rational decomposition. Strong two-monophonicity of all Johnson graphs (Brešar–Cornet–Dravec 2025) ALREADY implies the simple face characterization; it is expressly credited and not asserted as new. The established Goyal line-graph clique homotopy and published equivariant star-collapse of the clique subcomplex explain H_1 vanishing there and the known H_2 module, but neither computes the signed H_1 module created by the nonclique pairing edges. Full primary comparison with published geodesic and Horn-closure results and actual targeted searches found no equivalent equivariant statement. Search noncoverage is not a uniqueness proof, and an unindexed matching-module derivation remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unpublished/unindexed paper may give the same equivariant signed-matching representation, or a general theorem specialized here.
The base strong-two-monophonic classification and plain nonequivariant wedge are covered by prior published theorems, and are explicitly not asserted as original.
The rational Specht decomposition does not establish an integral Specht decomposition; no such assertion is made.
No independent expert or mathematical publication-priority audit has taken place.

value.rationale: V=PASS. The complete intrinsic integral relabelling-symmetry action on H_1 of a canonical graph-position complex distinguishes orientations of root matchings, which the Betti count and previously known clique homology do not determine. The theorem gives the exact lattice, all permutation traces, and a complete multiplicity-free Specht decomposition with six stable irreducibles and zero globally invariant rational classes. This is a natural equivariant classification tied to vertex-label symmetries, and it has explicit consequences for fixed subgroups; not an arbitrary finite computed slice or relabeling of a known H_2 theorem. It is a substantive refinement of already-known nonequivariant counts.
